messages:
alex-sales: FYI customer requested our pen-test + vuln scan evidence for their vendor risk review. dropping sanitized artifacts here, pls confirm we can share.

alex-sales: Attaching: <https://files.redwood.com/share/pen_test_redwood_q1_2026_sanitized.pdf|pen_test_redwood_q1_2026_sanitized.pdf> and <https://files.redwood.com/share/vuln_scan_2026-03-28.zip|vuln_scan_2026-03-28.zip> :paperclip:

secops-bot: Upload complete. Access set to customer-sme@acme.com (view only).

mira-sec: Thanks. Quick checklist before we hand over: 1) no customer PII in PDFs, 2) CVE identifiers mapped to our internal tracker, 3) remediation ETA per item. I scanned the PDF for PII, looks clean.

customer-sme: Appreciate it. Can you confirm which findings are outstanding vs. mitigated? Also need proof of re-scan after fixes (scan report + dates).

dan-eng: Short answer: 3 low findings are closed, 2 medium are in-progress (config fixes), 1 medium requires a patch in the runtime dependency (scheduled). Details below.

dan-eng: Findings summary (IDs match scan ZIP):
- SCAN-2026-045 (medium): open — deps/kv-cache runtime lib (patch PR ready, rollout scheduled 2026-04-14)
- SCAN-2026-052 (medium): in-progress — nginx config hardening; hotfix deployed to staging, prod rollout 2026-04-09
- SCAN-2026-013 (low): closed — misconfigured header, fixed 2026-03-30
- SCAN-2026-027 (low): closed — outdated package removed 2026-03-28
- SCAN-2026-089 (low): closed — info leak false positive accepted 2026-03-29

olivia-ps: For the buyer: we can provide signed attestation once re-scan confirms fixes. What do we want as the official timeline to send over?

mira-sec: Proposal:
- 2026-04-09: prod rollout for nginx hardening + verified smoke tests (already queued)
- 2026-04-14: runtime lib patch rollout to canary, monitor 48h
- 2026-04-16: full prod rollout if canary stable
- 2026-04-18: internal re-scan and generate evidence bundle (scan + diffs + change tickets)
- 2026-04-19: provide re-scan report + signed attestation to customer

customer-sme: That timeline works for procurement, but we need a clear owner for each item and a single contact for follow-ups.

dan-eng: Owners:
- ngx config hardening: dan-eng (ticket INF-4123)
- runtime lib patch: lee-runtime (PR #789) — I'll coordinate with Lee and post updates here
- closed/verified items: mira-sec (evidence collection)

alex-sales: I'll be the single point for procurement updates and will forward anything to the customer.

mira-sec: For evidence, we'll include: sanitized pen-test PDF, original vuln-scan ZIP (sanitized), signed remediation timeline PDF, re-scan output (Nmap/OSV-scan + Snyk/Trivy reports), and ticket links. Also include checklists showing no PII.

customer-sme: One more ask: can you include mappings from your internal tracker IDs to the SIG/CAIQ control statements they affect? Security team needs that for their vendor matrix.

mira-sec: Yes — I'll map SCAN IDs -> SOC2/CAIQ controls and attach a CSV.

dan-eng: Quick technical note for the runtime fix: patch backported to v2.4.1. Example verification command we will run post-deploy:
```
./infra/tools/run_vuln_check --target runtime-service --cves CVE-2026-XXXX
```

secops-bot: Reminder scheduled: re-scan job created (job id: rs-2026-559). Scheduled for 2026-04-18 02:00 UTC.

olivia-ps: Great — I'll draft the customer-facing remediation timeline email once we have final rollout times. Alex will approve.

alex-sales: Thanks all. Action items: dan to confirm PR/rollout dates by EOD, mira to prepare CSV mapping and attestation template, secops-bot will run re-scan and post results. I'll update customer and share any procurement docs. :thumbsup:
